toegepas.na: Dit stuur die boodskap as golwe
toegepas.rede_vinder: The sentence refers back to the message just mentioned, so the definite article reads better than a second 'n boodskap.
toegepas.fout: A second indefinite 'n boodskap right after the first reads as a new, unrelated message.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The definite article ties the sentence to the message just mentioned without changing what is said.

toegepas.rede_vinder: Inventions do not really 'happen' in Afrikaans; 'ontstaan' is the natural verb for an invention coming about.
toegepas.fout: Inventions do not naturally 'gebeur' in Afrikaans; the verb is loose.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Ontstaan' is the natural verb for an invention coming about, and the qualifier 'dikwels' is intact.

toegepas.voor: Jou radio maak net die een waarop jy instel
toegepas.na: Jou radio maak net van die een waarop jy instel
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Maak X weer klank' does not mean 'turn X back into sound'; 'maak van X weer klank' does, and matches the lesson's earlier 'maak van die patroon weer klank'.
toegepas.fout: 'Maak net die een ... weer klank' lacks the 'van' that 'turn X into sound' needs, so the reader stumbles.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Adding 'van' fixes the construction, matches the earlier 'maak van die patroon weer klank', and keeps the meaning.

laat_vaar.voor: Die golwe gaan wyd uit en nie net na een mens toe nie
laat_vaar.na: Die golwe versprei wyd en gaan nie net na een mens toe nie
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The second half has no verb of its own, which reads as a fragment; giving it 'gaan' and using 'versprei' makes both halves full and natural.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The elliptical second half is acceptable Afrikaans, and the proposal is longer with a harder verb for a Grade 4 reader.

laat_vaar.voor: uit Alfred Nobel se geld gegee word
laat_vaar.na: uit Alfred Nobel se geld toegeken word
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A prize is 'toegeken' in Afrikaans; 'gegee' is flat and sounds translated.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Gegee' is plain, correct wording for a Grade 4 glossary entry, and rewording a definition is not a language agent's change to make without a real fault.

na_skrywer.voor: Elke sein was net 'n eenvoudige sein
na_skrywer.na: Elke sein was net 'n eenvoudige teken
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: Avoids saying 'sein' twice in one short clause; 'teken' is the word the lesson's own glossary uses to define a sein, and the first 'sein' stays.
na_skrywer.fout: 'Elke sein was net 'n eenvoudige sein' is a tautology that says nothing about what the signal was.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but the fix removes an occurrence of the protected video word 'sein', so the writer must resolve it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: Dit stuur 'n boodskap as golwe sonder enige draad tussen die twee mense.
vlae.rede: 'Die twee mense' has not been introduced; the paragraph spoke of a carrier and of a wire between two places, so it is unclear which two people are meant. Fixing it means choosing content (for example who sends and who receives), so it is flagged rather than changed.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: net die een waarop jy instel
laat_vaar_vorige.na: net die golwe van die stasie waarop jy instel
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'die een' is ambiguous between a station and the waves, and it is the waves that the radio turns back into sound.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Die een' clearly means the station in context, and the proposal lengthens the sentence and repeats 'golwe' a third time in the paragraph.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The preposition 'langs' suggests travelling beside a wire; a message travels through a wire, and 'deur' matches the lesson's own usage.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Langs 'n draad' (along a wire) is correct, and this is a shared glossary definition where a preposition swap is a content change.
